text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst roaring cheers, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) gets underway. At the center of 
it all, Narita Brian radiates a beast-like 
pressure... yet her breathing is far too 
ragged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel heads to the race with 
fierce determination: to save the idol who 
was struggling in pain, and so that she 
herself could become someone Narita Brian 
looked up to.
